summary.intent: Browse pending GSD todos and start work on the highest-priority item — the user selected todo #9 to make the SDK client self-bootstrap its folder tree from the root IPNS key, eliminating the web-side seeding requirement.
summary.outcome: Todo #9 was moved to completed, a feature branch was created, STATE.md was updated, and a parallel code-exploration workflow was launched to map the SDK and web subsystems before implementation begins.

repo: CipherBoxClient owns folderTree state but its config holds rootIpnsName + rootFolderKey + vaultKeypair — not the root IPNS private key, which lives only in the web vaultStore. This forces the web to call ensureFolderRegistered before every folderTree-dependent method.
The 'Folder not loaded' bug class is a systemic consequence of this asymmetry: the SDK can't resolve or lazy-load folders autonomously.
Phase 47 (SDK folder-state and publish-path consolidation) exists in the roadmap with 5 plans (47-01..47-05), all unchecked — this todo is a superset of REQ-1 in that phase.
Todo #8 (route shared-folder writes through the SDK client) is adjacent SDK-ownership cleanup and should be coordinated with this work.

code.finding: CipherBoxClientConfig definition — missing rootIpnsKeypair field that needs to be added
folderTree-dependent methods that currently require web-side ensureFolderRegistered pre-call
restoreFromBin throws 'Target folder not loaded' after reload — pre-existing bug since PR #296, not caught by recycle-bin.spec.ts
Web-side hook that seeds folderTree via ensureFolderRegistered before SDK calls — to be removed once client self-bootstraps
SDK provider wiring — relevant to how rootIpnsKeypair will be passed from vaultStore to client config

workflow: GSD check-todos workflow fans out a parallel code-mapping workflow before implementation to avoid blind coding — understanding first, then implementation.
Todo bookkeeping (move to completed, STATE.md update, commit) is done immediately when 'Work on it now' is selected, before implementation starts.
